infobox.title: लिनक्स सेटअप — ओमार्की
infobox.imageCaption: Hyprland Wayland अलाक्रिटी टर्मिनल के साथ टाइलिंग WM

lead:
मैं चलाता हूँ **Arch Linux via Omarchy** — an opinionated 'omakase' developer distribution created by DHH (David Heinemeier Hansson, creator of Ruby on Rails). Omarchy ships के साथ Hyprland Wayland tiling WM, Neovim, Alacritty, Ghostty, और Tmux — a curated, pre-configured developer environment that skips weeks of manual configuration.

I set मेरे username to `libre` — consistent के साथ the FOSS-first philosophy that runs through मेरे [[privacy-stack|प्राइवेसी स्टैक]] और [[foss-coin|FOSS Coin]] परियोजना. I've forked Omarchy to a personal गिटहब repository so I can selectively apply upstream updates rather than taking everything DHH ships.

content.content:
**Omarchy** is described by DHH as 'omakase Arch Linux' — *omakase* being the Japanese restaurant concept where the chef selects the best dishes on your behalf. DHH applied this to Arch Linux: instead of spending weeks configuring a desktop from scratch, Omarchy gives you a complete, opinionated सेटअप in 15–30 minutes.

The repository has ~22,000 गिटहब stars (as of April 2026). It installs from an ISO, wipes the dedicated drive, और applies full-disk encryption by default. The Super key is the command centre के लिए all shortcuts.

rows.मैंने क्या किया: Kept — learning Lua के लिए config

content.content: मेरे daily workflow is keyboard-driven और terminal-centric. Almost no GUI applications are used के लिए development work — everything goes through the terminal.

rows.मैं इसका उपयोग किस लिए करता हूँ: Session और window management — persistent sessions that survive terminal restarts
Primary editor — still learning Lua के लिए config customisation
Fuzzy file find → open in editor
AI agent in accept-all mode — terminal-native pair programmer I call 'P.I.'
On-demand socket activation — reduces idle RAM on मेरे constrained [[homelab|homelab]] VM

content.title: ओमार्की v3.4+ परिवर्तन
content.content: Version 3.4 added Tmux by default (t alias), Claude Code as the default AI agent (cx alias, accept-all mode), hibernation enabled by default, और AI agent Tmux layouts: tdl, tdlm, tsl.

I've integrated **Claude Code** — I call it 'P.I.' (Personal Intelligence) in मेरे सेटअप — as a terminal-native AI agent. I have a custom `CLAUDE.md` at `/home/libre/CLAUDE.md` that describes मेरे personal workflow context.

मैं चलाता हूँ Claude Code in accept-all mode (`cx` alias) — it reads files, writes code, और executes shell commands without asking के लिए confirmation at each step. The Omarchy skill file (`github.com/robzolkos/omarchy-skill`) extends this के साथ Omarchy-specific context.

This has genuinely changed how I work: rather than memorising command syntax, I query in natural language और the agent executes the appropriate commands.

मैं उपयोग करता हूँ OBS Studio के लिए screen recording और video production, के साथ a specific audio configuration I tuned carefully:
- **Noise Gate:** Close threshold −32 dB / Open threshold −26 dB — eliminates background hiss between speech
- **RNNoise suppression:** AI-based noise cancellation plugin
- **Mic:** CMF Buds 2 Pro via PulseAudio

मैं उपयोग करता हूँ **Shotcut** as मेरे video editor. The entire production pipeline is Linux-native और free software — no Adobe products anywhere.

content.title: आकस्मिक टर्मिनल हटाना — मैंने क्या सीखा
content.content: I once accidentally removed all terminal emulators while cleaning packages. Recovery: Ctrl+Alt+F2 to drop to TTY2, log in, reinstall Alacritty or Ghostty via pacman from the framebuffer terminal. The TTY is always available even when the graphical session has no terminals — I know this the hard way now.
